hero_prompt: English. A row of self-service customs kiosks with blank glowing screens beside an empty airport baggage check-in counter in a bright, high-ceilinged Japanese departure hall at early morning, cool blue daylight from tall windows, wide-angle low viewpoint, a small paper shopping bag resting on a hard-shell carry-on suitcase in the foreground. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand names, no real people's faces.
